_comment: Where a boat route may arrive and a dialog teleport may lead (docs/03-world-and-maps.md "Validación"). Read by arrivals.test.ts here (make validate) and by server/internal/session (TestArrivalsFixture, session.New), so both refuse the same arrivals. The field: island "test", 64x64 grass on floor 7 from (0,0), its temple at (0,0) and the captain harbor_master at (8,10) with its dock at (8,11). rows are drawn over it from origin: . grass; # stone_wall; D forge_gate, closed; d forge_gate, placed open (a double gate of one room). houses: by "x,y,w,h" (rect on floor 7), with a door and an exit by "x,y"; the house of index i is h<i>. Each case is one arrival: by a boat route or a dialog teleport (of the NPC puerto_priest), to "x,y" on floor 7; error: why it is refused (house: on a house tile; door: on a locked door placed open; walkable: on no walkable tile), none when it is fine.
